summary: Updated clamav packages fix security vulnerabilities
details:
The updated packages fix security vulnerabilities:
PE File Format Processing Out-of-Bounds Memory Corruption Vulnerability.
(CVE-2026-20213)
FSG File Format Processing Out-of-Bounds Memory Corruption
Vulnerability. (CVE-2026-20214)
7Zip File Format Processing Out-of-Bounds Memory Corruption
Vulnerability. (CVE-2026-20215)
InstallShield File Format Processing Resource Exhaustion Vulnerability.
(CVE-2026-20216)
PESpin File Format Processing Out-of-Bounds Memory Corruption
Vulnerability. (CVE-2026-20217)
ALZ Archive Processing Denial of Service Vulnerability. (CVE-2026-20243)
DMG File Processing Denial of Service Vulnerability. (CVE-2026-20244)
